body.x: RisingCraft (CEO: Lee Junseo) announced its participation in CES 2024, taking place in Las Vegas from January 9th (Tuesday) to 12th (Friday) local time.

As a neuroscience-based digital therapeutic device startup, RisingCraft is developing ‘TiU,’ a software that rehabilitates the brain’s visual mechanism using XR technology. Through this innovation, they aim to surpass temporal and spatial limitations, providing infinite rehabilitation possibilities and offering practical rehabilitation opportunities to patients with brain injuries in the medical field, optimizing functionality and enhancing the quality of life.

Leveraging years of expertise in the XR field, RisingCraft initiated the development of TiU, the Brain Cognitive XR Rehabilitation program. A RisingCraft representative explained, “Rehabilitation therapy for hemiplegia utilizing the brain’s visual mechanism is an exciting development in modern medicine and neuroscience. We use XR technology to stimulate the brain visually, showcasing normal movements in abnormal body parts, thereby promoting the brain’s plasticity and providing new rehabilitation opportunities for hemiplegic patients.”

Specifically, XR technology enhances the efficacy of mirror therapy by providing immersive experiences, enabling patients to participate in various scenarios. It simulates actual activities in a virtual environment, allowing patients to gain confidence and transform these skills into enhanced functions in daily life.

Through tailored treatment and exercise programs, it’s possible to consider individual patient conditions, optimize treatment approaches, create personalized treatment plans, and achieve the effects of exercise. Additionally, by storing patient data in the cloud through SaaS-based services, continuous monitoring of patient progress is facilitated, enabling real-time feedback to adjust treatment plans.

Utilizing the brain’s visual mechanism in mirror therapy provides new rehabilitation opportunities for hemiplegic patients, promotes functional recovery, and ultimately enhances daily life functions by stimulating regular movements in damaged areas, facilitating bypassing or improving the function of substitute parts.

RisingCraft has been selected for various R&D projects and has received investment from the Incheon Creative Economy Innovation Center, ensuring continuous growth. They plan to expand further and conduct high-level research through future investment rounds.

An official stated, “The investment round scheduled for early next year is a crucial step for our continued growth and innovation. Through this, we aim to strengthen our technological competitiveness and explore new market opportunities.” They added, “Additionally, by expanding investments in research and development, we will introduce innovative products and services, establishing a leading position in the market.”

Furthermore, they expressed their aspirations: “Through exposure and feedback gained from CES 2024, we aim to strengthen our position in the global market and explore new market entries.” They added, “Moreover, based on the collaborative possibilities derived from CES 2024, we seek to enhance strategic partnerships, develop marketing strategies considering local market characteristics, collaborate with local partners, and achieve global expansion.”
